name: finddata-coding-crew
description: A five-role coding crew with typed contracts: planner slices the work, explorer and implementer run in parallel, merger carries every branch constraint forward, verifier gates the result. Ships the agent-graph-gate skill that checks the collaboration graph's shape before dispatch.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 五角色协作编码班底，带类型化契约：规划者切片、侦察与实现并行、合并者承接各分支约束、验收者把关；附带派发前检查协作图形状的 agent-graph-gate 技能。
